CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_ATM
AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer
AS
(
SELECT
BAC.CLT_ID AS AtmCustomerId
,BAC.CLT_CIF_NUMBER AS RelatedCustomerId
,'Previous Card' AS RelationshipTypeId
,BAC.CLT_CREATED_TS  AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,BAC.CLT_UPDATED_TS AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS RelatedPaymentCardNote
,BAC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'ATM' AS SourceSystemCode
,BAC.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
,BACD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT_DELTA BACD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.ATM_CLIENT BAC ON BAC.CLT_ID = BACD.CLT_ID AND BAC.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer FROM TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer;


--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
AtmCustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
)) HASHROW, AtmCustomerId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),


TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
AtmCustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
)) HASHROW, AtmCustomerId
FROM BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer
),

TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.AtmCustomerId, TGT.AtmCustomerId) AS AtmCustomerId
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <>  TGT.AtmCustomerId THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_TGT TGT
ON SRC.AtmCustomerId = TGT.AtmCustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
AtmCustomerId = SRC.AtmCustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId = SRC.RelatedCustomerId
,RelationshipTypeId = SRC.RelationshipTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp
,RelatedPaymentCardNote = SRC.RelatedPaymentCardNote
FROM BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.AtmCustomerId = TGT.AtmCustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer SRC ON SRC.AtmCustomerId = TGT.AtmCustomerId;

--INSERT TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer
(
AtmCustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId
,RelationshipTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,RelatedPaymentCardNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
AtmCustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId
,RelationshipTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,RelatedPaymentCardNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,'ATM' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_DELTA;


END
